title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
snippet: Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and two DeepSeek models, both heuristics fail in predictable places. Selecting by relevance readmits decoys, because decoys are on topic: even a perfect relevance filter loses 23 to 31 points to rarest-first selection in the classic hidden-profile configuration.

title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report 2026 Q3: More swarms, fewer giants
snippet: Mirai-classified mitigation peaked in August at 57.23 PB, representing 46.5% of all mitigated network-layer bytes in Q3, including four days — August 16, 19, 23, and 25 — that each cleared three petabytes. title: LNG imports make up increasing share of Colombia's natural gas supply
snippet: In 2025, hydropower supplied 81% of the country’s electricity, natural gas supplied 8%, and coal supplied 4%. By comparison, hydropower made up 55% of the country’s electricity in March 2024, the last strong El Niño year, while natural gas-fired generation rose to 22% and coal-fired generation rose to 15%.
